summary.en: The pulse look: grounds that walk one hue's lightness ramp and a tinted white, white type on the dark steps, amber only for the answer, huge condensed black words at one anchor, a mono query line.
summary.zh: pulse 的样式：底色沿一个色相的明度阶梯走（四级加一档带色的白），深底白字，琥珀色只标答案，极窄黑体大字落在同一锚点，下方一行等宽查询行。

fits: A question with a measured answer: version releases, benchmarks with one winner, a configuration that passes a limit; teasers of 12–40 s.
notFor: Stories without a measurable question; many numbers; anything that needs more than five words at once or a second accent.

intent.en: The beat becomes visible: every word lands on a new ground of the same hue, so the film feels like a query run live, and amber can only mean the answer.
intent.zh: 把节拍变成看得见的东西：每个词落在同一色相的新底色上，像一次现场跑的查询；琥珀色只可能是答案。

content.en: One question (≤ 5 words a state), its real candidates with measured values, the answer, two or three supporting figures.
content.zh: 一个问题（每个状态 ≤ 5 个词），真实候选项和测得的值，答案，两三个佐证数字。

fits.zh: 有测量答案的问题：版本发布、只有一个赢家的跑分、过了某个上限的配置；12–40 秒的预告。

notFor.zh: 没有可测问题的故事；数字很多；一次要读五个词以上或要第二个强调色的片子。

pairs.note: its sound: a muted kick on every beat, the drop on the whiteout

en: Never colour anything but the answer amber.
Coral puts the accent on ramp[0] and ramp[1] only (`accentOn`).
zh: 除了答案，任何东西都不许用琥珀色。
珊瑚红预设只在 ramp[0]、ramp[1] 上用强调色（`accentOn`）。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
